description: This file defines configuration options for Cassandra clustering within Orleans, including TTL settings, retry delays, and client configuration methods.

classes.name: CassandraClusteringOptions
classes.description: Options class for configuring Cassandra clustering, TTL settings, and client connection behavior.

methods.name: GetCassandraTtlSeconds
methods.description: Calculates TTL in seconds based on cluster options if TTL is enabled.

methods.name: ConfigureClient
methods.description: Overloaded methods for configuring the Cassandra client either via connection string or delegate.
